name: city_country
description: Retrieve a city's country, as opposed to copying an explicitly supplied country in matched format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
groups={'France':['Paris','Lyon','Marseille','Toulouse','Nice','Bordeaux'],'Germany':['Berlin','Munich','Hamburg','Frankfurt','Cologne','Dresden'],'Canada':['Toronto','Ottawa','Montreal','Vancouver','Calgary','Winnipeg'],'China':['Beijing','Shanghai','Guangzhou','Shenzhen','Chengdu','Wuhan'],'Japan':['Tokyo','Osaka','Kyoto','Yokohama','Nagoya','Sapporo'],'Italy':['Rome','Milan','Naples','Turin','Florence','Venice'],'Spain':['Madrid','Barcelona','Seville','Valencia','Bilbao','Granada'],'Brazil':['Brasilia','Rio de Janeiro','Sao Paulo','Salvador','Recife','Fortaleza']}
rows=[(city,country) for country,cities in groups.items() for city in cities]
items=[];control=[]
for city,country in rows:
 for template in ['City: {city}. In which country is this city? Answer with the country only:','Geography quiz. {city} is a city in which country? Country:']:
  items.append({'prompt':template.format(city=city),'answer':' '+country})
  label=random.choice(list(groups))
  control.append({'prompt':f'City: {city}. Country label: {label}. Copy the country label exactly. Country:','answer':' '+label})
random.shuffle(items);random.shuffle(control)
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
